title: Fix blank Q1 Sales Performance report: map spec `columns`/`field` to ReportViewer `fields`/`name`
body:
The Q1 Sales Performance report rendered blank because `@objectstack/spec` defines reports with `columns[].field`, while `ReportViewer` expects `fields[].name`. The `ReportView` boundary layer mapped `label→title` but was missing the `columns→fields` mapping. ### Changes - **`apps/console/src/components/ReportView.tsx`** — Extend spec→types mapping in the boundary layer: - `columns[].field` → `fields[].name` - `columns[].aggregate` → `fields[].aggregation` + `showInSummary` - Auto-generate `sections` (summary + table) when absent - **`apps/console/src/__tests__/ReportView.test.tsx`** — Add assertions verifying column headers and data rows actually render (previous test only checked title/toolbar) ### Before/After The mapping follows the existing `label→title` pattern already in `ReportView`: ```typescript // Before: only title mapping const reportForViewer = reportData.title ? reportData : { ...reportData, title: reportData.label }; // After: full spec→types boundary mapping const mapped = { ...reportData }; if (!mapped.title && mapped.label) mapped.title = mapped.label; if (!mapped.fields && Array.isArray(mapped.columns)) { mapped.fields = mapped.columns.map((col) => ({ name: col.field || col.name, label: col.label, ...(col.aggregate ? { aggregation: col.aggregate, showInSummary: true } : {}), })); } // Auto-generate sections when missing if (!mapped.sections && mapped.fields) { /* summary + table */ } ``` The metadata in `objectstack.shared.ts` is unchanged — it correctly uses `columns`/`field` as required by `defineStack()` validation.
Original prompt > > ---- > > *This section details on the original issue you should resolve* > > 报表界面 Q1 Sales Performance 显示为空白：元数据未严格遵守 spec 协议导致无法渲染 > ### 问题截图 > > > ### 问题描述 > 进入 CRM → Sales Report → Q1 Sales Performance 页面，报表区域显示为空白，表头描述可见。 > > ### 深入分析 > - 当前报表元数据 `sales_performance_q1` 只声明了 `columns` 字段（field），而不是 spec 协议中约定的 `fields`（name），也缺少标准的 `sections`。 > - `ReportViewer` 组件渲染 fallback 路径高度依赖 `fields`，导致数据内容无法显示。 > - 数据初始化与后端接口（objectName: opportunity）均正确，不属于数据源或业务逻辑问题。 > > ### 结论 > **所有元数据定义都必须严格遵循 spec 协议，否则前端报表渲染将出现兼容性问题。** > > ### 修复建议 > - 移除所有非标准字段，严格按照 spec 协议定义： > - 用 `fields` 取代 `columns`，并将属性名统一为 `name`。 > - 建议补全 `sections`，并明确各 section 类型和结构。 > - 参考如下标准写法： > > ```typescript > { > name: 'sales_performance_q1', > label: 'Q1 Sales Performance', > description: 'Quarterly analysis of sales revenue by region and product line', > objectName: 'opportunity', > type: 'summary', > fields: [ > { name: 'name', label: 'Deal Name' }, > { name: 'amount', label: 'Amount', type: 'number', aggregation: 'sum', showInSummary: true }, > { name: 'stage', label: 'Stage' }, > { name: 'close_date', label: 'Close Date' } > ], > sections: [ > { type: 'summary', title: 'Key Metrics' }, > { > type: 'table', > title: 'Deal Breakdown', > columns: [ > { name: 'name', label: 'Deal Name' }, > { name: 'amount', label: 'Amount' }, > { name: 'stage', label: 'Stage' }, > { name: 'close_date', label: 'Close Date' } > ] > } > ] > } > ``` > > ### 待解决事项 > - 检查和整改所有报表、对象等元数据字段定义，避免再次出现自定义字段或与 spec 协议冲突的属性。 > - 修正后需全面回归报表功能并更新 roadmap。 > > ### 影响评估 > - 非标准元数据将导致报表等页面渲染异常，影响终端用户数据可视化使用。 > > --- > *注：强烈建议所有新开发、维护及 review 人员严格以 spec 协议为唯一元数据标准。* > > ## Comments on the Issue (you are @copilot in this section) > > > >
